label: D2 after a rewarded-then-repeated a2 choice, early in the episode (strongest on rare a2->S1)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (never D1/GO), only when this trial chose a2 (in_action==2) and the previous trial was rewarded (prev_reward==1; since the previous choice was also a2 in all active cases, this is a rewarded a2 that was repeated). It is also restricted to the first ~30 trials of the episode (rate 4% in trials 0-29, ~0 after trial 40, none in trials 0-2), a time dependence with no task explanation. All variables are observed at D2; no future variables used. Magnitude: ~75% of activation mass is on rare transitions (a2 -> S1); common a2 -> S2 gives weaker activations; adding common==0 raises precision to 0.68 but drops recall to 0.54. Activations sit where the policy logit is moderately a2-favouring (choice in [-8.9,-4.4]), never when strongly a2 or a1-favouring. Precision of the recorded predicate is low (~0.32): many qualifying early-episode D2 steps, especially common S2 ones, stay inactive. Does not fire after a1, after unrewarded previous trials, or late in the episode.
